faqs.a:
(a)
Fees shall be as set forth and in accordance with the provisions of division 2, article
               VII of chapter 2 of the Code. Fees shall be non-refundable and will not be pro-rated
               for partial years.
(b)
All fees collected pursuant to this chapter shall be applied to the cost of administering
               this chapter.
(Ord. No.
4733
, § 1, 6-15-2020)
